scope: Jake-requested homepage amenities focus; no article publication

checks.channel_and_overlap: Homepage/CSS only. Blog articles, generator, schedule, policies, gallery catalog, analytics and booking scripts untouched.
checks.final_render: Four widths checked, with mobile photo-crop refinement; zero horizontal overflow or broken page images. Provider-origin fetch errors logged separately from site errors.

sources.finding: Club advertises public golf by required tee time, availability limited and member preferred times; homepage links direct without promising access.
